title: V2ProjectDocument
description: Durable V2 project: authoritative SlideScene collection plus identity, revision, and migration seam. V2-6A version 1. Scenes validate against the Layer-C scene schema separately; this schema owns the envelope only.

id.description: Stable project id. Minted once at creation, never regenerated on save/load.

schemaVersion.description: Stored format version. Readers accept exactly 1; unknown future versions refuse (never silently repair).

revision.description: Durable save revision. Incremented by the store on every successful save; the in-memory engine revision is separate and restarts at 0 on load.

origin.description: How the project came to be. Records the creation path so later slices can distinguish generated, human-authored, customized, and detached content at the project level; per-slide provenance stays on the scenes themselves.

scenes.description: Ordered authoritative SlideScene collection. Order and ids are significant; a save/load cycle never regenerates element or slide ids.
